caption:
Your happiest customer never gets asked for a referral.

They just finished a good job. They're grateful. Nobody follows up to make that gratitude useful.

Example workflow Black Arrow builds: a job closes in the CRM, a referral text goes out days later once the result has proven itself. The link ties to the original customer's record, so credit lands on their account when their friend books. One reminder if nothing happens, then the sequence stops.

Illustrative workflow, not a specific client account.

DM SCALE
#ServiceBusiness #HomeServices #ContractorMarketing #CRM #ReferralMarketing
rationale: Carousels/slideshows still lead B2B saves and depth, and an automated post-job referral-ask sequence using the platform's referral tracking feature is a genuinely unclaimed demonstration distinct from every prior follow-up, review, day-of-service, and reactivation system already shipped.
